items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Louis would come in there, and then everybody’d see him and then run to Joe, and Joe, you know how he was: “Give everybody a drink!”

ctx.x: Joe Louis would come in there, and then everybody’d see him and then run to Joe, and Joe, you know how he was: “Give everybody a drink!” So the man said, “You’ve got to play a little set for Joe.”
So you were playing for a full spectrum of society.
